reviews.review_description:
Reading other reviews, I’m not sure if it’s a me issue….
1.  Broom is uncomfortable to use.  I had to twist my wrist uncomfortably to sweep floor.
2. I finished first 2 tasks and purchased power washer.  When I go to first power wash task, the screen glitches and I am unable to proceed..unable to close app.  I had to hard crash my very twice to exit game.

I would love to proceed and hope fixes are made as this seems like a good void replacement for my favorite, powerwash sim.

UPDATE: Issue #2 is resolved.  Thank you!  However, please see below.

3. Little House level - I went outside to empty trash and was not able to get back in the house.  Beautiful house by the way.
4. Race car - When I clean the tires, the area I cleaned gets back dirty.  It gives me credit for cleaning it but the dirty look takes away from the satisfaction of cleaning it.
5. When you pick up "cleaning liquid" for the power washer, it is upside down in the hand making it difficult to attach.  Pretty much the same issue with the broom, the hand in game doesn’t pick it up in a human way.

This is the farthest I have gone in the game so far.  Waiting on updates.

I love the graphics but the game mechanics need some testing and correcting.  :)
I gave another star for you caring enough to not only read the reviews but to work on a solution.  Thank you!

developer_response.body:
Thank you so much for the detailed feedback and for giving the game another chance! We really appreciate you taking the time to share your experience and helping us improve.

We’re happy to hear that the power washer issue has been resolved. We also fixed the Little House level issue, and you can now freely go in and out of the house.

Regarding the race car tires, what you’re seeing is not the dirt coming back — it’s the water being removed from the wheel after cleaning. The tire is still considered cleaned, but we understand how it can feel confusing. We also improved the dirt visuals to make the difference between dirty and clean surfaces much clearer, making the cleaning process feel more satisfying.

The broom handling has also been improved, and the issue with the cleaning liquid tank being upside down has been fixed as well.

We’re constantly working on improving the game and making the experience better for everyone. Thank you again for your patience, support, and valuable feedback. We hope you enjoy the latest update and have fun cleaning!

reviews.review_description:
2nd followup - the link you provided returns "file not found". I did put the water attachment in my blue circle. Tutorial says put it in the power washer. Can't. Cannot get past that screen.
Followup question for Developer: I put trash in the dumpster, trash can tips over. Can't pick it up without changing height in settings. Stuck. Again. "Take the power wash and put the water attachment inside the power wash..." How???

This app needs so much work to be functional. Cannot get thru tutorial. Cannot bypass. The actual game never begins. Stuck on putting little square attachment on gun. There's nowhere to put the dang thing and no further guidance. So I've gotten as far as i can, which is stuck in the tutorial. Broom is terribly awkward to hold and use. I was so excited to get the app, but so far the biggest dud I've purchased. Also, if you drop the broom, you must go into settings and adjust your height to be able to pick it up, then go and set height back to continue.  Super dumb and useless so far.

developer_response.body:
Hi! Thank you for your patience and for taking the time to explain all the issues you encountered.

We’re sorry that you got stuck in the tutorial and couldn’t properly start the game. We’ve made improvements to the tutorial, including fixes for the broom handling, the power washer attachment interaction, and other issues that could block player progress.

We also wanted to share the updated tutorial guide here in case you’d like to give it another try:
https://youtu.be/j4k7abkbGn8

We hope the latest update provides a much smoother experience. We really appreciate your feedback because it helped us identify and fix these issues, and we’ll continue working on improving the game. Thank you!

reviews.review_title: Perfect title for relaxing in VR!
reviews.review_description: Perfect title for relaxing in VR!  The game was just released and it already has great mechanics and graphics. The developer promised content updates every second week. With the price presented no need to wait for purchase.

developer_response.body: Thank you for the kind words and for supporting the game! We're thrilled you're enjoying the experience. We have plenty of updates planned and can't wait to share more with everyone. Enjoy!

reviews.review_description:
Ever thought cleaning could be this addictive? Welcome to Cleaning Simulator VR, a game that taps into that weirdly satisfying urge to scrub, polish, and tidy up—but with a virtual twist that’s oddly therapeutic! This isn’t just any cleaning game; it’s a well-crafted, varied, and downright fun experience that proves even the most mundane tasks can be a blast in VR.

Dive into a world where your mop, sponge, and trusty Karcher become tools of relaxation and accomplishment. You start with the basics—simple tools and straightforward jobs—but as you complete cleaning tasks and keep your clients happy, you’ll earn cash to upgrade your gear. Want a more powerful vacuum? A faster pressure washer? The game rewards your hard work, letting you build the ultimate cleaning arsenal.

What’s truly brilliant about Cleaning Simulator VR is how it turns routine chores into a series of satisfying mini-missions. Need to clean a grand fountain? Break it down into manageable tasks: scrub the basin, polish the statues, and don’t forget the hidden nooks! Washing a car? Start with the wheels, move to the chassis, and finish with the suspension—each step feels like a small victory. And when you finally stand back to admire your sparkling results? Pure joy.

But the fun doesn’t stop at ground level! Access ladders to reach those hard-to-clean spots, adding a dash of challenge and exploration to your cleaning spree. The Karcher is a game-changer—literally—blasting away grime with satisfying pressure, but beware: those recharges can be pricey, forcing you to strategize your cleaning sprees.

Whether you’re in the mood for a relaxing afternoon scrubbing a serene statue or a high-stakes race to clean a filthy race car before time runs out, Cleaning Simulator VR delivers. It’s quirky, it’s fun, and it might just make you appreciate the art of cleaning a little more. So, grab your virtual gloves, fire up that mop, and get ready to turn cleaning into your new favorite hobby—without the sore back!
I love this game it offers relaxing and enjoying gameplay. The environements are amazing and the idea of having mini games made it even more enjoyable. I highlyy recommend it!
